note: Mutants for the test cleanup of round 2 (the name-lookup-free HTTP servers and the runner's job limit) for tools/mutate.py: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/test_speed_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1 --timeout 900. (The python tests run with their own empty bytecode folder: a mutant that keeps a file's size and time would otherwise be read from a stale .pyc, and the baseline would fail.) Every mutant must be caught by the test that the 'expect' names.

mutants.test: env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=$(mktemp -d) python3 -m unittest tests.scripts.test_quick_http
